annotations.title: YouTube search results for one query

description: Searches YouTube for one query and returns the ranked result videos with title, URL, channel, views, duration and date. Use it to find videos on a topic, or to see which channels rank for a query. Use job_youtube_channel instead for one known channel's uploads. Use job_google_trends instead for search interest over time. Cost: $0.0001 per result row plus $0.0009 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most result rows to return and pay for (default 20, at most 200); the run stops there.

query.description: The search text, as typed into YouTube (one line, up to 200 characters).

name: job_youtube_search

items.description: {rank, type, id, url, title, viewCount, date, duration, durationSeconds, channelName, channelUrl}

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)
